description: Read Active Decisions from sibling PAPI projects that share the same Supabase instance. Requires PAPI_SIBLING_PROJECT_IDS env var (comma-separated project UUIDs). Returns ADs labelled by source project — useful for cross-project architectural alignment. pg adapter only — returns an error if using md or proxy adapter.

project_ids.description: Optional explicit list of sibling project UUIDs to query. If omitted, falls back to PAPI_SIBLING_PROJECT_IDS env var.

name: get_sibling_ads
